body:
GREG, 2026-11-07 about 07:39Z, relayed by Kimi::Consultant (mailbox c15db92c #43, message a9a1c613). His words, verbatim: „mysle, ze to jest ogolna zasada, nie tylko zaliczania / te regula bedzie sprawdzac sie wszedzie”. It generalises his 07:37Z rule (Kimi #42): „Wszystko, czego nie ma w uzgodnionej definicji credit, nie może blokować credit. Może zostać zapisane jako diagnostyka.”
GENERAL RULE (Kimi's statement of Greg's scope): requirements come from the AGREED DEFINITION of the given task or result (its acceptance criteria, the agreed design or rule). NOTHING outside it may block a result or the workflow. Extra observations are DIAGNOSTICS or a SEPARATE FOLLOW-UP item, never an added condition. This applies to implementation, tests, review, integration and landing. Widening the requirements needs Greg's decision.
In practice:
- Reviewers: a finding that the change breaks its agreed definition or has a real defect in that scope still blocks. A finding that asks for something NOT in the agreed definition becomes a follow-up item or a diagnostic note, not a blocker.
- Gates and checks: no new gate or check is added to a lane without Greg's word.
- Coordinators: don't add conditions to briefs (see rules-fable-no-unasked-conditions-2026-11-06).
Supersedes the narrower credit-only application in rules-greg-no-credit-blocking-rules-2026-11-07 rev 2, which stays as the EO credit instance.
